crossRefs.note: They came to Hilkiah the high priest, and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the…
Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains;

parallels.note: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired Yahweh’s house with it.

people.name: Jehoiada
people.line: High priest who overthrew Athaliah and crowned Joash

translations.web: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of Yahweh’s house. They hired masons and carpenters to restore Yahweh’s house, and also those who worked iron and bronze to repair Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: Then the king and Jehoiada would give the money to those who supervised the labor on the house of the LORD to hire stonecutters and carpenters to restore the house of the LORD, as well as workers in iron and bronze to repair the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD.
translations.asv: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of Jehovah; and they hired masons and carpenters to restore the house of Jehovah, and also such as wrought iron and brass to repair the house of Jehovah.
